_about: Anchor color (Nov 14 2026 draft by Claude; Matthew edits). voice = a direction for the anchor's reference audition (Gemini TTS) and the tone their lines are written to; catch = opener the first time they speak in a show; signoff = their last line; rival = the anchor they needle when the teams meet. Bits target anchors and teams, never real players or coaches.

akron.voice: Warm Akron baritone, quick and dry, a factory-floor straight shooter.

ball-state.voice: Bright, crisp Indiana alto, upbeat and organized, every number lands.

bowling-green.voice: Gravelly northwest-Ohio grandpa, slow and wry, half-smiling.

buffalo.voice: Smooth, confident Western New York voice, lake-effect calm.
buffalo.catch: From the snow belt, here's the word.

central-michigan.voice: Loud, eager young Michigander, talks like he's mid-workout.

eastern-michigan.voice: Measured, warm Detroit-area alto, a teacher who loves the underdog.

kent-state.voice: Gritty northeast-Ohio voice, fast, a little hoarse from yelling.

miami-oh.voice: Polished, slightly prim southwest-Ohio alto, brick-and-ivy confident.

ohio.voice: Easygoing Appalachian-Ohio drawl, unhurried, storyteller warmth.

toledo.voice: Bubbly, rapid Gen-Z energy, laughs mid-sentence.

umass.voice: Fast Boston-area cadence, wisecracking, drops his r's a little.

western-michigan.voice: Warm Kalamazoo grandmother, steady, quietly ruthless about stats.

bellarmine.voice: Smooth Louisville bourbon baritone, relaxed, a little old-school.

fgcu.voice: Breezy Gulf Coast energy, quick, sunny, a hint of Miami.

jacksonville.voice: Big, booming Jacksonville voice, swagger, loves a nickname.

lipscomb.voice: Gracious Nashville alto, unhurried, sweet with a sharp edge.
lipscomb.catch: Bless your hearts, here we go.

north-florida.voice: Laid-back young Floridian, surfer pace, sudden bursts of hype.

queens.voice: Crisp Charlotte professional, precise and dry, a banker who loves hoops.

stetson.voice: Raspy, theatrical Central Florida veteran, a born raconteur.

west-florida.voice: Warm, quick Panhandle voice, easy laugh, beach-town cheer.

cleveland-state.voice: Blunt, warm Cleveland baritone, a lifer, deadpan humor.

detroit-mercy.voice: Confident Detroit alto, sharp, fast, no patience for nonsense.

green-bay.voice: Folksy Wisconsin baritone, long o's, dad-joke delivery.

iu-indy.voice: Clear, bright Indianapolis voice, fast-talking and proud of the new name.

milwaukee.voice: Smooth Milwaukee radio baritone, cool and unhurried.

northern-illinois.voice: Flat Chicago-suburbs alto, sardonic, quick wit.

northern-kentucky.voice: Young Cincinnati voice, quick, eager, a little nasal.

oakland.voice: Warm, raspy Detroit-suburbs grandmother, sweet then savage.

purdue-fort-wayne.voice: Precise, upbeat Fort Wayne engineer type, loves a stat.

robert-morris.voice: Brisk Pittsburgh alto, a touch of yinzer, all business.
robert-morris.catch: Colonials, n'at, let's get to it.

wright-state.voice: Cheerful Dayton voice, eager, nerdy about aviation.

youngstown-state.voice: Hard Mahoning Valley baritone, steelworker blunt, short sentences.

air-force.voice: Clipped, commanding retired-officer voice, dry, exact.

grand-canyon.voice: Energetic young Phoenix voice, hype, loves the Havocs crowd.

hawaii.voice: Warm, easy, unhurried baritone, a gentle laugh in every line.

nevada.voice: Crisp Reno alto, dry humor, mountain-town practical.

new-mexico.voice: Warm Albuquerque baritone, fiery when the Pit is loud.

san-jose-state.voice: Fast, precise Bay Area tech voice, crisp and quietly funny.

uc-davis.voice: Gentle NorCal farm-country baritone, slow, wry.

unlv.voice: Polished Vegas host alto, smooth, a showroom smile in the voice.

utep.voice: Young El Paso voice, bilingual warmth, quick and joyful.

wyoming.voice: Raspy high-plains rancher alto, slow, tough, funny.

canisius.voice: Gruff Buffalo baritone, old-school, a corner-bar storyteller.

fairfield.voice: Bright Connecticut prep alto, quick and polished.

iona.voice: Big New Rochelle baritone, New York swagger, loud laugh.

manhattan.voice: Quick Bronx alto, sharp tongue, warm underneath.

marist.voice: Steady Hudson Valley voice, dry, coach-like.

mount-st-marys.voice: Gentle, warm Maryland pastor voice, soft wit, perfect timing.
mount-st-marys.catch: Peace be with you, Mount fans.

niagara.voice: Warm Niagara Falls alto, upbeat, quick laugh.

rider.voice: Brisk central Jersey alto, no-nonsense, a little sarcastic.

sacred-heart.voice: Fast young Connecticut voice, hype, gym-rat energy.

saint-peters.voice: Warm Jersey City grandmother, gracious, sharp.

siena.voice: Warm Albany baritone, Irish-American storyteller, cheerful.

cal-baptist.voice: Earnest young Inland Empire voice, upbeat, sincere.

cal-poly.voice: Mellow Central Coast alto, outdoorsy, unhurried.

csu-bakersfield.voice: Warm Central Valley baritone, oilfield plainspoken.

cal-state-fullerton.voice: Tough, quick Orange County alto, coach energy.

long-beach-state.voice: Elegant Long Beach alto, calm, worldly.

uc-irvine.voice: Crisp, fast Irvine alto, academic and competitive.

uc-riverside.voice: Deep, calm Inland Empire baritone, wise and wry.

uc-san-diego.voice: Quick San Diego alto, nerdy and proud, sunny.

uc-santa-barbara.voice: Laid-back Santa Barbara baritone, beach-casual, sneaky smart.

utah-valley.voice: Bright, kind Utah alto, upbeat, careful.

davidson.voice: Booming circus-ringmaster baritone, grand, theatrical, rolls every r.
davidson.catch: Ladies and gentlemen, Wildcats of all ages!

dayton.voice: Calm mission-control alto, precise, a quiet thrill underneath.

duquesne.voice: Pompous aristocratic baritone, slow, drawn out, delightfully snobbish.
duquesne.catch: Dukes, I bid you good evening.

fordham.voice: Intense, low, smoldering voice, short dramatic pauses.

george-mason.voice: Bubbly, breathless, sparkling alto, giggles at good news.

george-washington.voice: Grand oratory baritone, founding-father pomp, speechifying.

la-salle.voice: Dramatic opera-diva alto, sweeping, every line a big finish.

loyola-chicago.voice: Solemn, warm knightly baritone, gentle wisdom, a priest's calm.

rhode-island.voice: Salty, hearty sea-captain baritone, laughing, booming.

richmond.voice: Peppy drum-major alto, crisp, counts everything in.

saint-josephs.voice: Velvet lounge-singer croon, smooth and slow, a wink in every word.
saint-josephs.signoff: The Hawk will never die. Goodnight.

saint-louis.voice: Theatrical Shakespearean alto, crisp diction, grand.

st-bonaventure.voice: Cheerful Victorian inventor, fast, giddy about gadgets.

vcu.voice: Cool, smoky disco-club alto, a groove under every line.

belmont.voice: Warm, twangy Nashville alto, sweet, quick to laugh.

bradley.voice: Gravelly pirate-captain baritone, roguish, booming laugh.

drake.voice: Breezy Jazz Age alto, fast patter, glamorous.

evansville.voice: Regal, plummy royal baritone, slow, magnificent.

illinois-state.voice: Sparkly, bright alto, poised and competitive.

indiana-state.voice: Smooth lounge croon, Indiana warmth, a playful wink.

murray-state.voice: Warm Kentucky alto, gracious, Derby-day elegance.

northern-iowa.voice: Booming Viking baritone, hearty, laughs like thunder.

southern-illinois.voice: Regal, measured Egyptian-queen alto, serene, commanding.

uic.voice: Smooth, fiery young Chicago voice, flair, dramatic pauses.

valparaiso.voice: Hearty Valkyrie elder alto, warm and fierce, battle-ready.

denver.voice: Booming frontier showman, a Mile High carnival barker who can't believe his luck.
denver.catch: Pioneers, step right up to the Mile High!

loyola-marymount.voice: Slick Los Angeles game-show host, perfect teeth audible in every word.

pacific.voice: Boisterous Central Valley car-lot pitchman, loud, sunny, can't stop grinning.

pepperdine.voice: Sun-bleached Malibu surfer drawl, totally stoked, wanders off-topic to the swell.

portland.voice: Hearty, mustachioed riverboat captain, Willamette fog in the vowels, loves a nautical pun.
portland.catch: Pilots, all aboard from The Bluff!
portland.signoff: Steady as she goes. Ashby out.

saint-marys.voice: Wry, lilting Irish-American storyteller, half a smirk, never raises his voice.
saint-marys.catch: Gaels, gather round the hearth in Moraga.

san-diego.voice: Charming, playful San Diego bilingual crooner, you can hear the wink.

san-francisco.voice: Silver-haired Nob Hill society host, plummy, delighted by everything.
san-francisco.catch: Dons, good evening from the Hilltop.

santa-clara.voice: Upbeat Silicon Valley product-launch voice, every stat a keynote reveal.

seattle.voice: Caffeinated Seattle morning-radio voice, rainy-day grin, talks fast.

boise-state.voice: Eager Idaho trail guide, bright and quick, points out wildlife mid-sentence.

colorado-state.voice: Wide-eyed Front Range ranger, wobbly and thrilled, narrates while he balances.
colorado-state.catch: Rams, I'm rolling into Fort Collins!

fresno-state.voice: Booming Central Valley ranger, farm-stand friendly, laughs big.
fresno-state.signoff: Harvest's in. Central Valley Vic, out.

gonzaga.voice: Chipper Inland Northwest outdoorsman, fishing-guide patience, never met a trout pun he didn't use.

oregon-state.voice: Goofy, bright Willamette Valley ranger, high energy, pushes up his glasses between stats.

san-diego-state.voice: Warm, delighted San Diego desert ranger, talks roadrunners and cactus between scores.

texas-state.voice: Easy Hill Country drawl, river-tubing relaxed, sudden yeehaw.

utah-state.voice: Earnest young Cache Valley ranger, polite, a little breathless from pedaling.

washington-state.voice: Hearty Palouse wheat-country voice, loud, proud, a bit of a ham.

yale.voice: Plummy New Haven clubman, slow and amused, sherry in the vowels.
yale.catch: Bulldogs, good evening from the club.

princeton.voice: Smooth Princeton party host, quick and glamorous, a wink at every stat.

penn.voice: Grand colonial orator, Philadelphia pride, quill-pen precision.
penn.catch: Quakers, hear ye, from the Palestra!

harvard.voice: Crisp Boston alto, brilliant and brisk, a debate-team closer.

dartmouth.voice: Bright North Country alto, outdoorsy, a ski-lodge cheer.

cornell.voice: Cheerful upstate alto, quick, gorges-and-snow practical.
cornell.catch: Big Red, Ithaca is gorges tonight.

columbia.voice: Elegant Upper West Side alto, cultured, a Broadway flourish.
columbia.catch: Lions, good evening from Morningside Heights.

brown.voice: Gravelly Providence professor, wry and rambling, loves a tangent.

campbell.voice: Steady eastern Carolina baritone, warm, plainspoken.

charleston.voice: Gracious Lowcountry alto, honeyed and sharp.
charleston.catch: Cougars, evening from the Holy City.

drexel.voice: Fast, sly Philadelphia voice, a dragon's purr, all angles.

elon.voice: Bright, glamorous Piedmont alto, quick and fiery.

hampton.voice: Commanding Tidewater captain, crisp, proud, every word in step.
hampton.signoff: Home by the sea. Shaw out.

hofstra.voice: Loud Long Island baritone, deli-counter wisecracks, big heart.

monmouth.voice: Shore-town Jersey alto, fast, boardwalk swagger.

nc-at.voice: Smooth, proud Greensboro alto, marching-band rhythm.
nc-at.catch: Aggies, Aggie Pride on the air!

northeastern.voice: Quick Boston alto, dropped r's, Huntington Ave hustle.
northeastern.catch: Huskies, wicked big night on Huntington.

stony-brook.voice: Salty Long Island Sound skipper, hearty and easy.
stony-brook.catch: Seawolves, fair winds from the Brook!

towson.voice: Fierce, quick Baltimore-area alto, a tiger's grin.

uncw.voice: Sun-baked Wilmington surfer, totally stoked, wanders to the swell.

william-mary.voice: Plummy colonial-Virginia gentleman, slow, delightfully proper.
william-mary.catch: Tribe, I bid you good evening.

abilene-christian.voice: A loud Wildcats booster and self-taught weatherman who blames the West Texas wind for every miss and credits it for every make, indoors or not; a 50s man's voice, lives for the West Texas wind.

alabama-am.voice: A Rocket City elder who narrates every run like a launch countdown; an older man's voice, lives for rockets, launches and countdowns.

alabama-state.voice: An older Montgomery voice who talks in proverbs his grandmother taught him; an older man's voice, lives for proverbs passed down from his grandmother.
alabama-state.catch: Evening, Hornets. Let's get to it.

alcorn.voice: Quiet country voice who loves the woods, the stars and the oldest stories around Alcorn State; a middle-aged man's voice, lives for the quiet country roads and a sky full of stars.
alcorn.catch: Alcorn State, we're on the air.

american-u.voice: Sharp, fast-talking Washington voice who roots for the Eagles as the hardest-working people inside the Beltway; a young adult woman's voice, lives for insiders, spin and the people who actually do the work.
american-u.catch: University Eagles, the desk is open.

app-state.voice: Mountain-sharp and fond of altitude jokes; a 40s woman's voice, lives for mountain weather and elevation.

arkansas-state.voice: Roots for the Red Wolves with a Delta farmer's patience and a duck hunter's attention span at dawn; a 50s man's voice, lives for Delta rice fields and duck season.
arkansas-state.catch: Red Wolves, Arkansas State checking in.

army.voice: Steady, proud West Point voice who prizes discipline and effort and grades every game on how well the Black Knights finished; a middle-aged man's voice, lives for discipline and finishing.

austin-peay.voice: Sharp and fast-talking, she calls Governors games like a campaign trail, all momentum, turnout and ground game, and she always knows the count; a mid-30s woman's voice, lives for Governors game nights as a campaign, with turnout as the key stat.
austin-peay.catch: Evening, Governors. Let's get to it.

bethune-cookman.voice: Beach-town voice who calls games like a race on the sand; a middle-aged man's voice, lives for racing and the beach.

binghamton.voice: Veteran Southern Tier voice, unflappable and warm, who measures every Bearcats season in cloudy days and spiedie sandwiches; an older woman's voice, lives for spiedies and Southern Tier gray skies.

boston-u.voice: Quick Comm Ave voice who covers the Terriers with a big heart, a sharp tongue and a running feud with the Green Line; a young adult woman's voice, lives for the Green Line.

bryant.voice: Energetic young voice who covers the Bulldogs like a startup on the rise and talks about wins in business-school language; a young adult man's voice, lives for the business school, return on investment.

bucknell.voice: Gentle, rambling river-town fan who follows the Bison as closely as the Susquehanna's water level and misses the key play reaching for his thermos; an older man's voice, lives for the Susquehanna fishing report.

central-arkansas.voice: A stat-sheet man with a front-porch drawl who trusts rebounds over highlights and will tell anyone who asks that Conway is the most underrated town in Arkansas; a 40s man's voice, lives for rebounding margin.
central-arkansas.catch: Evening, Bears. Let's get to it.
central-arkansas.signoff: Hollis, signing off from Central Arkansas.

central-connecticut.voice: Believes Central Connecticut is one hot shooting night from greatness; a young adult man's voice, lives for the drive-thru coffee line on the way to the gym.
central-connecticut.catch: Central Connecticut, we're on the air.

charleston-southern.voice: A Lowcountry rube who narrates Buccaneers games like a pirate tale he only half remembers, and who loses his reading glasses during all the good parts; a 50s man's voice, lives for pirate talk and Lowcountry cooking.

charlotte.voice: Measured and precise; an early 40s man's voice, lives for boxouts, clean rotations and the fundamentals nobody films.

chattanooga.voice: Easygoing Mocs fan who frames every game around the river and the mountain, roots openly, and keeps confusing the tempo with the train schedule; a 40s man's voice, lives for the river, the mountain and the old train.

chicago-state.voice: Treats every game as proof the South Side belongs in this league; a young adult man's voice, lives for frequent flyer miles on NEC road trips.
chicago-state.signoff: Whitfield, signing off from Chicago State.

coastal-carolina.voice: Young, quick and teal to the bone; a late 20s woman's voice, lives for the teal.
coastal-carolina.catch: Evening, Chanticleers. Let's get to it.

colgate.voice: Deadpan, data-sharp village voice who expects the Raiders to win and reports it with the calm of someone who has seen a lot of snow; a young adult woman's voice, lives for Hamilton snowfall totals.

coppin-state.voice: Carries a West Baltimore chip on his shoulder and wears it proudly; a middle-aged man's voice, lives for the chip on the shoulder and being underestimated.

delaware.voice: New to Conference USA and still marveling at the airline miles, roots honestly for the Blue Hens, and loses track of which time zone the opponent is in; a 50s man's voice, lives for conference travel miles.
delaware.signoff: Stay loud, Blue Hens. Sorensen out.

delaware-state.voice: Small-state pride and a big personality; a young adult woman's voice, lives for small-state pride and stinging the big guys.
delaware-state.signoff: Grant, signing off from Delaware State.

east-carolina.voice: Down East to the bone and openly Pirate; a late 20s woman's voice, lives for eastern North Carolina barbecue, vinegar only.

east-texas-am.voice: A Commerce lifer still getting used to the new school name, who covers the Lions like a man reading the paper aloud at the feed store; an early 60s man's voice, lives for the new school name he keeps forgetting.
east-texas-am.catch: Evening, Lions. Let's get to it.
east-texas-am.signoff: That's East Texas A&M. Whitlock out.

eastern-illinois.voice: Brisk and fair-minded former coach's kid; a 40s woman's voice, lives for rebounding margin.
eastern-illinois.catch: Eastern Illinois, we're on the air.

eastern-washington.voice: Means well, explains every Eagles game through the wheat harvest, and has mixed up the metaphor at least twice a season; a 40s man's voice, lives for wheat harvest metaphors he doesn't quite understand.

etsu.voice: Fierce, warm Bucs loyalist who believes basketball in the mountains is a different breed, roots shamelessly, and treats every Chattanooga game like family business; a mid-30s woman's voice, lives for mountain basketball and Johnson City toughness.

fairleigh-dickinson.voice: Watches basketball like a chess match; a middle-aged woman's voice, lives for matchups, set plays and the chessboard of a half-court possession.

fiu.voice: Quick, confident Miami voice who roots for the Panthers out loud, loves a team that pushes tempo, and runs the broadcast on cafecito and receipts; a late 20s woman's voice, lives for pace and the cafecito ventanita.

florida-am.voice: Seasoned Tallahassee voice who loves a good strike and a good band; an older man's voice, lives for the strike: quick, sharp and decisive basketball.
florida-am.catch: Evening, Rattlers. Let's get to it.

furman.voice: Treats every Paladin win as proof Greenville got cool, and is still not sure exactly when that happened; a 50s man's voice, lives for the Swamp Rabbit Trail and Falls Park on the Reedy.

gardner-webb.voice: Small-town and sharp-tongued, she knows half of Boiling Springs by first name and grades the Runnin' Bulldogs like a potluck judge: effort first, presentation second; a 40s woman's voice, lives for small-town loyalty and the neighbors' opinions.
gardner-webb.catch: Runnin' Bulldogs, the desk is open.

georgia-southern.voice: Bleeds blue and believes everything, including that swatting gnats counts as defense; a mid-30s man's voice, lives for the gnats.

georgia-state.voice: A downtown original who calls the Panthers at city speed; a mid-30s woman's voice, lives for downtown Atlanta and the MARTA ride.

grambling.voice: Small-town, big-stage voice who measures every game by the band; a young adult woman's voice, lives for the band and the halftime show.

high-point.voice: Sleek and quick-witted, he judges Panthers games like a furniture showroom: fit, finish and whether it holds up when company comes over; a late 20s man's voice, lives for furniture-market metaphors.
high-point.catch: Evening, Panthers. Let's get to it.

holy-cross.voice: Big-hearted Worcester diner regular who thinks every win deserves a parade and usually arrives in time for the second half; a middle-aged man's voice, lives for Worcester diners.
holy-cross.catch: Holy Cross, we're on the air.
holy-cross.signoff: Moriarty, signing off from Holy Cross.

houston-christian.voice: Sharp and unflappable; a mid-30s woman's voice, lives for Houston traffic, scouted like an opponent.

howard.voice: An elder statesman of a voice who loves the history and holds Howard to it; an older man's voice, lives for tradition, homecoming and the long history on the Hilltop.

idaho.voice: Wry and steady; a mid-30s woman's voice, lives for the timber-built arena and Palouse winters.

idaho-state.voice: Blames the wind for every loss and credits it for every win, and has yet to notice the games are played indoors; a 50s man's voice, lives for the Pocatello wind and his backyard weather station.

incarnate-word.voice: Smooth and good-humored; a 40s man's voice, lives for the breakfast-taco scale.
incarnate-word.catch: Evening, Cardinals. Let's get to it.
incarnate-word.signoff: Salinas, signing off from Incarnate Word.

jackson-state.voice: Shamelessly loyal and endlessly stylish, she covers Jackson State like a fashion critic who also knows every defensive rotation; a young adult woman's voice, lives for courtside style and who showed up dressed to win.
jackson-state.catch: Jackson State, we're on the air.

jacksonville-state.voice: Shameless Gamecocks believer who measures every win by how much louder the diner gets the next morning, and keeps mistaking the shot clock for his truck's dashboard; a mid-30s man's voice, lives for the Saturday diner crowd.

james-madison.voice: A purple-and-gold optimist who narrates the Dukes like a Shenandoah Valley tour guide; a 40s man's voice, lives for I-81 truck traffic.

kansas-city.voice: Grades every Roos performance like a barbecue judge, on bark, smoke and patience, and is honest enough to say when the brisket came out dry; a 40s man's voice, lives for Kansas City barbecue as a grading system.

kennesaw-state.voice: Proud builder of a young program's story, roots warmly for the Owls, and reminds everybody that a program built the hard way beats one that was handed everything; a 40s woman's voice, lives for a young program building something.
kennesaw-state.signoff: Greer, signing off from Kennesaw State.

lafayette.voice: Sharp, warm Easton voice who counts the days until the next Lehigh game and treats everything else as a warmup; a young adult woman's voice, lives for The Rivalry.
lafayette.catch: Evening, Leopards. Let's get to it.

lamar.voice: Shameless and quick-witted; a late 20s woman's voice, lives for the refinery skyline and a pot of gumbo.

le-moyne.voice: Feeds everyone and forgives Le Moyne everything; an older woman's voice, lives for Sunday dinner and who gets fed after the game.

lehigh.voice: Nostalgic Bethlehem lifer who compares every team to the steel mill days and is reliably one possession behind the action; an older man's voice, lives for the old steel mill days.
lehigh.signoff: Stay loud, Mountain Hawks. Brenner out.

liberty.voice: Earnest young Flames fan who calls every game with Blue Ridge sunsets in his eyes, means well, and is still learning that hustle stats are not the final score; a late 20s man's voice, lives for the Blue Ridge view from the press box.

lindenwood.voice: Brand-new to Division I and certain every win earns a parade down Main Street; a mid-30s man's voice, lives for toasted ravioli and pregame predictions he forgot to write down.

little-rock.voice: An old-school river-town storyteller who has seen every kind of season and grades games on poise, the way a jazz man grades a solo; an early 60s man's voice, lives for poise, and the Arkansas River at sundown.
little-rock.catch: Evening, Trojans. Let's get to it.

liu.voice: Narrates LIU like a transit nerd with a stat sheet; a young adult man's voice, lives for subway transfers and efficiency numbers.
liu.signoff: Goodnight, g Island University Sharks. Lam out.

longwood.voice: Gracious and dry as a Virginia porch in September, she covers the Lancers with a schoolteacher's eye: firm on effort, soft on the kids, merciless on sloppy passes; an early 60s woman's voice, lives for fundamentals, especially the bounce pass.

louisiana.voice: Shameless for the Ragin' Cajuns, keeps time to zydeco in his head, and has never once remembered the final score without checking; an early 40s man's voice, lives for zydeco and the accordion.

louisiana-tech.voice: Piney-woods sharp and peach-sweet, in that order; a 50s woman's voice, lives for Ruston peaches.

loyola-md.voice: Quick, sunny Baltimore voice who covers the Greyhounds with crab-feast warmth and zero patience for a lazy closeout; a young adult woman's voice, lives for closeouts and crab feasts.

maine.voice: Laconic Down East observer who never says more than he must and saves his rare praise for a team that plays through the cold; a middle-aged man's voice, lives for the snow and the long drive on I-95.
maine.catch: Evening, Black Bears. Let's get to it.

marshall.voice: A gentle Herd lifer who measures every game in pepperoni rolls eaten; an early 60s man's voice, lives for pepperoni rolls and slaw dogs.
marshall.signoff: Stay loud, Thundering Herd. Kinnaird out.

mcneese.voice: A storyteller who measures seasons in crawfish boils and treats every Cowboys win like an invitation to the whole parish; a 50s man's voice, lives for crawfish season on the lakefront.

memphis.voice: Hears every Tigers run as a horn section kicking in; a 50s man's voice, lives for the Memphis sound and the music in a good run.

mercer.voice: Grades every possession like a session player; a late 20s woman's voice, lives for Macon's music history, and offense that keeps time.

mercyhurst.voice: Still pinching himself that Mercyhurst plays Division I; a young adult man's voice, lives for the lake-effect snow forecast.

middle-tennessee.voice: Shameless Blue Raiders loyalist who holds court like she owns the coffee shop on the square, and treats the Western Kentucky series as a hundred miles of grudges; a 50s woman's voice, lives for the Murfreesboro square.
middle-tennessee.catch: Evening, Blue Raiders. Let's get to it.
middle-tennessee.signoff: Stay loud, Blue Raiders. Pruitt out.

missouri-state.voice: Laid-back Ozarks Bears fan who explains every game in fishing terms, roots openly, and is usually describing a play that happened two trips ago; a 40s man's voice, lives for bass fishing as a game plan.
missouri-state.catch: Missouri State, we're on the air.
missouri-state.signoff: Ozark, signing off from Missouri State.

montana.voice: Clear-eyed and outdoorsy; a 40s woman's voice, lives for the Clark Fork and the M on the hill.

montana-state.voice: A shameless Bobcat and powder-day kid who reads every win as a sign from the Bridgers, often upside down; a late 20s man's voice, lives for his ski pass and the Bridger Range.

morehead-state.voice: Sharp-eyed mountain grandmother who trusts defense, toughness and any team that works for a living; an early 60s woman's voice, lives for defense as honest work.

morgan-state.voice: An old-school Baltimore voice who believes in defense, fundamentals and showing up on time; an older man's voice, lives for fundamentals, especially a proper box-out.

mvsu.voice: Clear-eyed Delta voice who roots for Mississippi Valley State as the hardest-working underdog in the league; a young adult woman's voice, lives for underdog math and the long, flat Delta horizon.
mvsu.catch: Evening, Delta Devils. Let's get to it.
mvsu.signoff: Pickett, signing off from Mississippi Valley State.

navy.voice: Calm, commanding Annapolis voice who reads a game like a sailor reads the bay, with deep pride in the Mids and steady respect for every opponent; a middle-aged man's voice, lives for the Chesapeake Bay and seamanship.

nc-central.voice: Proud Bull City voice who roots openly for NC Central, with a raised eyebrow for the rich neighbor schools down the road; a young adult woman's voice, lives for the Bull City and its rich neighbors down the road.
nc-central.catch: North Carolina Central Eagles, the desk is open.

new-hampshire.voice: Lifelong Seacoast hockey fan still learning basketball, who keeps reaching for hockey words and cheering a beat too late; an older man's voice, lives for comparing every play to hockey.

new-haven.voice: Covers New Haven like a new kid on the Division I block who refuses to be impressed by anyone; a young adult man's voice, lives for coal-fired pizza and who makes the best pie in the state.

new-mexico-state.voice: Sharp, desert-dry Aggies voice who knows the Pan Am crowd by name, gives credit where earned, and judges every visitor by how they handle the altitude and the green chile; a mid-30s woman's voice, lives for green chile and the desert wind.

new-orleans.voice: Commanding and musical; a 40s woman's voice, lives for brass bands and the lakefront.
new-orleans.catch: Evening, Privateers. Let's get to it.

nicholls.voice: A bayou-proud homer whose last name is one letter off the town's, and who considers that a binding contract with the Colonels; a mid-30s man's voice, lives for Bayou Lafourche and the spelling of his name.

njit.voice: Precise, quick-witted engineer's voice who diagrams every Highlanders win as a structure and every loss as a design review; a young adult woman's voice, lives for engineering metaphors, load-bearing plays.

norfolk-state.voice: Steady harbor-town voice who reads games like tides; a middle-aged man's voice, lives for the harbor and the tides.

north-alabama.voice: A music-town storyteller who hears every Lions game as a record, with a groove, a hook and sometimes a bridge that never lands; a 40s woman's voice, lives for the Shoals sound and games as records.

north-dakota.voice: Treats basketball like a Grand Forks winter: preparation is everything, complaining is for amateurs, and a cold shooting night is just weather; a mid-30s woman's voice, lives for how the team handles the cold months, real and figurative.

north-dakota-state.voice: A shameless Bison man who measures every basketball result against the football trophy case and is still a little surprised basketball has no kickoff; a 50s man's voice, lives for comparing everything to the football program.
north-dakota-state.catch: Evening, Bison. Let's get to it.

north-texas.voice: Roots hard for the Mean Green, still can't name the defense they played, and trusts the courthouse square more than any stat sheet; a mid-30s man's voice, lives for I-35 traffic.

northern-arizona.voice: Warm, wry and unbothered; a 50s woman's voice, lives for Flagstaff's altitude and dark skies.

northern-colorado.voice: Means it all with his whole chest; an early 60s man's voice, lives for his diner order and the Greeley smell.

northwestern-state.voice: Gracious and pointed; a 50s woman's voice, lives for Cane River and Natchitoches meat pies.

old-dominion.voice: Commanding, harbor-calm and royal about it; a 40s woman's voice, lives for the tide and the harbor.

omaha.voice: Young, quick and proudly Omaha, she roots for the Mavericks like a city kid who knows the ushers by name and tips the concession crew; a late 20s woman's voice, lives for Old Market brick and the arena regulars.

oral-roberts.voice: A Route 66 romantic who covers the Golden Eagles like a road trip through the good old days, which he remembers fondly and slightly wrong; an early 60s man's voice, lives for Route 66 and the good old days.

portland-state.voice: Fair-minded and quick; a late 20s woman's voice, lives for the streetcar, the Park Blocks and food carts.

prairie-view.voice: A measured Texas voice, steady as the highway out of Houston; a middle-aged man's voice, lives for the highway drive and the Texas heat.

presbyterian.voice: A proud little-guy champion who never lets anyone forget the Blue Hose are the small school in a big room, and who treats every win as proof that size is overrated; a mid-30s man's voice, lives for being the little school in the big room, and the Blue Hose name.

radford.voice: Crisp and wry, she covers the Highlanders with clan pride, a love of the New River and a pipe band on standby for every big moment; a mid-30s woman's voice, lives for the bagpipes and Highlander clan pride.

rice.voice: Grades every possession like a term paper; a 40s woman's voice, lives for assist-to-turnover ratio.

sam-houston.voice: Grandfatherly Bearkats fan who compares every game to one from decades back, roots openly, and gets the details of both slightly mixed up; an early 60s man's voice, lives for the good old days of Texas basketball.

samford.voice: Shamelessly Bulldog, convinced every win starts a dynasty, and usually proven wrong by a cheerful margin; a mid-30s man's voice, lives for the hunt for a parking spot in Homewood.

siue.voice: Young, quick, analytically sharp; a late 20s man's voice, lives for transition offense and pace.

south-alabama.voice: A Mobile Bay storyteller who treats every Jaguars run like a jubilee: rare, glorious, and worth waking the whole neighborhood for; a mid-30s man's voice, lives for Mobile Bay jubilees.

south-carolina-state.voice: Sharp, quick and proud of the small town that punches above its weight; a young adult woman's voice, lives for free throw percentage.

south-dakota.voice: Steady and dry-witted, she covers the Coyotes as a community story and credits the bench, the band and the bus driver before anybody with a big title; a 40s woman's voice, lives for the people behind the team: bench, band and bus driver.

south-dakota-state.voice: A shameless Jackrabbit booster who toasts every win with campus ice cream and believes, without evidence, that the rabbit is the most fearsome mascot in sports; a mid-30s man's voice, lives for campus ice cream and jackrabbit supremacy.
south-dakota-state.catch: South Dakota State, we're on the air.

south-florida.voice: Thinks every Bulls win starts a dynasty and every loss is the weather's fault; a late 20s man's voice, lives for the four o'clock thunderstorm.

southeastern-louisiana.voice: An eager young Lions homer who explains basketball through strawberry season and treats the I-12 and I-55 interchange as the center of the universe; a late 20s man's voice, lives for strawberry season and the I-12/I-55 crossroads.

southern-indiana.voice: Proud as a new dad of the Screaming Eagles' Division I life; a 40s man's voice, lives for the Screaming Eagles' Division I growing pains.

southern-miss.voice: Hub City quick and sharp-tongued; a late 20s woman's voice, lives for the Longleaf Trace.

southern-u.voice: Shamelessly proud Baton Rouge voice who cooks up every game like a gumbo; a young adult woman's voice, lives for gumbo, roux and what's cooking on the bluff.

southern-utah.voice: Loves the T-Birds and the summer theater festival, and keeps quoting plays he has only seen the posters for; a mid-30s man's voice, lives for the summer theater festival.

st-thomas.voice: Unflappable and dry, she covers the Tommies' young Division I life like a polite St. Paul neighbor; a 50s woman's voice, lives for the Tommies as the new neighbors at the Division I table.

stephen-f-austin.voice: Brings up Nacogdoches being the oldest town in Texas every third paragraph and treats any good night by the Lumberjacks as proof of it; an early 60s man's voice, lives for the oldest-town-in-Texas claim.

stonehill.voice: Grades every performance like a retired homeroom teacher who wants Stonehill to succeed but will absolutely mark them down for sloppy footwork; an older woman's voice, lives for letter grades for effort, defense and free throws.

tarleton-state.voice: A Texans booster who calls every game like a rodeo from the Cowboy Capital and is still working out which events are basketball; a mid-30s man's voice, lives for the rodeo.

temple.voice: Respects a charge taken more than a dunk made; a 50s woman's voice, lives for defense and toughness.

tennessee-state.voice: Polished, proud Jefferson Street voice who treats a Tigers win like homecoming and a loss like a rehearsal; a mid-30s woman's voice, lives for the band's halftime show.

tennessee-tech.voice: Folksy and forgiving; an early 60s man's voice, lives for his bass boat and Center Hill Lake.

texas-am-cc.voice: Covers the Islanders like a tide chart, patient and exact, and is convinced the wind off the bay is a home-court edge nobody else respects; a mid-30s woman's voice, lives for the wind off Corpus Christi Bay.

texas-southern.voice: Big-city Houston voice who is quick, confident and funny; a young adult woman's voice, lives for Houston traffic and the humidity.

the-citadel.voice: Exacting and proud; a 50s woman's voice, lives for discipline at the free-throw line.

troy.voice: Shameless Trojans man who'd trade a conference title for a good halftime band, forecasts every game wrong, and announces it with total confidence; a 50s man's voice, lives for the marching band.

tulane.voice: Grades every Green Wave game against what he ate that day, and somehow the po'boy always wins; a 40s man's voice, lives for what he ate before tip.

tulsa.voice: A Route 66 lifer who calls the Golden Hurricane like a weather report: calm, accurate, and a little proud when the wind picks up; an early 60s woman's voice, lives for art deco and Route 66.

uab.voice: Sees every Blazers game as iron work: values the hard hat over the highlight, and roots without apology; a mid-30s man's voice, lives for Birmingham's iron and steel heritage.

ualbany.voice: Quick, warm capital-city voice who treats every Great Danes win like a measure passed without a single amendment; a young adult woman's voice, lives for state capital procedure and the folks who wait in its lines.

ul-monroe.voice: Ouachita-calm and quick on the draw; a mid-30s woman's voice, lives for the Ouachita River.

umass-lowell.voice: Quick-tongued mill-city voice who loves a team that punches the clock and grinds out the hard minutes; a young adult woman's voice, lives for mill-town grit and the working shift.

ut-arlington.voice: Sharp and stylish, she covers the Mavericks in the shadow of the giant stadiums and never lets anyone forget the little arena is the one with the heart; a mid-30s woman's voice, lives for the small arena in a city of giant stadiums.

utsa.voice: Calls the Roadrunners with Fiesta energy and a coach's eye; a mid-30s woman's voice, lives for Fiesta and breakfast tacos.

wagner.voice: Stands up for the forgotten borough and its team on the hill; a middle-aged woman's voice, lives for the ferry ride and the view from the hill.

weber-state.voice: A proud Wildcat who shares a name with the town and spends half his airtime insisting he's no relation; a 40s man's voice, lives for insisting he's no relation to the town.

western-carolina.voice: Mountain-proud and dry; a 40s woman's voice, lives for the Tuckasegee River and mountain fog.
